prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 35 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1472; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain and stiffness consistent with cervical strain. The mechanism of injury is plausible for a crash of this type. Over the course of 35 visits, treatment followed a conventional progression, including manual therapy, stretching, range-of-motion exercises, and a home exercise program. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as functional recovery occurred. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the reported injury, while neurological screening, reflexes, and motor strength remained within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered without duplication. Patient was discharged to self-directed home care with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
